slo_title: To enable students to understand the role of human beings in existence

mcq.q: Which of the following is an element of right human conduct?
Why is human conduct central to existence?

options.A: Because humans can consciously understand and ensure harmony
options.C: Because humans are physically stronger than animals

mcq.answer_text: Because humans can consciously understand and ensure harmony

mcq.q: What is meant by human conduct?

options.B: The expression of values and understanding in daily life through behavior and actions

mcq.answer_text: The expression of values and understanding in daily life through behavior and actions

mcq.q: What happens when human conduct lacks right understanding?

options.B: It results in exploitation, conflicts, and imbalance

mcq.answer_text: It results in exploitation, conflicts, and imbalance

mcq.q: What is the ultimate goal of human conduct?

options.B: Achieving harmony within self, with others, and with nature

mcq.answer_text: Achieving harmony within self, with others, and with nature

sq.q: Why is right understanding important for human conduct?
answer: Right understanding helps humans act responsibly, ensuring peace, prosperity, and harmony with existence.

sq.q: What is meant by human conduct?
answer: Human conduct refers to the way a person lives and behaves in harmony with self, family, society, and nature.

lq.q: Explain prosperity in the light of harmony between Self and Body.
answer: Self-regulation means the feeling of responsibility toward the Body for its nurturing, protection and right utilisation. Health means the Body acts according to the Self and the parts of the Body are in harmony. The programme to ensure self-regulation and health gives priority to four areas: intake and routine, labour and exercise, posture and regulated breathing, and medicine and treatment. Intake includes air, water, sunlight, food and sensory inputs. Routine includes proper rising time, sleeping time and eating time. Labour produces physical facility, while exercise supports the health of the Body. Postures and regulated breathing help regulate the internal and external organs. Medicine and treatment are required when the Body temporarily moves away from harmony. This programme helps the Self take responsibility for the Body naturally, not through fear or force.
